headline: An Agentic Playbook for Authorized Bug Hunting
lede: Claude-BugHunter turns 83 specialized skills and hundreds of vulnerability patterns into a disciplined red-team workflow. It keeps reconnaissance, validation, evidence, and reporting inside a defined engagement boundary.

headline: Superpowers Gives Coding Agents a Method
lede: Superpowers replaces improvisational code generation with requirements discovery, tested plans, isolated worktrees, and reviewable execution. Its 327,035-star repository signals how quickly developers are embracing structure for autonomous software work.

headline: CLI-Anything Makes Software Agent-Ready
lede: CLI-Anything wraps desktop apps, games, developer tools, and services in structured command-line harnesses. Its registry and validation loops give agents a rugged route from natural-language intent to real artifacts.

headline: MiniMind Teaches the Small-Model Stack
lede: MiniMind lays out the full construction plan for a compact language model, from tokenization and pretraining through alignment, tool use, and serving. Its low-cost, native PyTorch workflow makes modern model training legible on consumer hardware.

headline: Cursor Plugins Connect Agents to Work
lede: Cursor’s plugin catalog packages coding skills, service integrations, and repeatable workflows behind a common manifest format. The result is an extensible bridge from engineering tasks to the business systems where teams already operate.

headline: Firecrawl Turns the Live Web Into Context
lede: Firecrawl handles rendering, crawling, rate limits, and structured extraction so agents can work with dynamic sites instead of stale snippets. Markdown, JSON, screenshots, and interactive actions form a high-throughput path from web pages to usable context.

headline: NGINX Keeps Traffic Moving Under Load
lede: NGINX remains a compact, modular engine for serving content, terminating TLS, balancing requests, and caching at the edge. Its master-worker architecture and text-based configuration keep performance and operational control close to the metal.

headline: OpenVINO Optimizes Models for Intel Silicon
lede: OpenVINO converts models from major training frameworks into an optimized runtime representation for CPU, GPU, and NPU inference. Quantization, sparsity, serving, and broad language-model integrations turn deployment efficiency into a measurable engineering target.

headline: Diagram Design Draws Systems on a Grid
lede: Diagram Design transforms plain-language prompts into polished, standalone HTML and SVG diagrams across 44 visual formats. Grid checks, brand extraction, and exportable files give agent-generated architecture visuals a precise finish.

headline: Last30days Builds Evidence From the Present
lede: This research skill assembles recent signals from communities, news, markets, video, repositories, and academic sources into an attributable brief. Parallel searches and source-weighted evidence help replace scattered browsing with a compact record of what changed this month.
